models_evaluated: LLM chatbot with clinical calculator tools and RAG over calculator metadata

links.outcome: Calculation and metadata-query accuracy of grounded chatbot versus unassisted LLM
links.effect: Metadata queries 100% accurate; calculation accuracy 86.4% vs 61.8% (sentences) and 79.2% vs 62.0% (shorthand); errors 0% vs 16.8% and 2.4% vs 18%.
links.quote: It eliminates calculation errors when prompted with complete sentences (0% vs. 16.8%) and greatly reduces them when prompted with medical shorthand (2.4% vs. 18%).

links.outcome: Clinical calculation error rate of unassisted off-the-shelf LLM
links.effect: Unassisted LLM calculation accuracy was 61.8% (complete sentences) and 62.0% (medical shorthand), with error rates of 16.8% and 18%.
links.quote: Our chatbot achieves 100% accuracy on queries interrogating calculator metadata content and shows a significant increase in clinical calculation accuracy vs. the off-the-shelf LLM when prompted with complete sentences (86.4% vs. 61.8%) or with medical shorthand (79.2% vs. 62.0%).

unlisted_practices: Routing LLM clinical calculation requests to verified software calculators via tool calls rather than LLM arithmetic

screen.practice: tool-calling to verified calculators plus retrieval grounding
screen.reason: Empirically tests adding tool-use verification and RAG metadata to an LLM versus an unassisted LLM to safeguard against clinical calculation errors.

primary.practice: tool use with verifiable calculators and RAG grounding
